introHtml: Kaset-Nawamin is not a tourist district, but for anyone with business at Kasetsart University, Paolo Kaset Hospital, or the Chatuchak-Ratchayothin corridor, this area offers genuinely good-value accommodation at prices far below central Bangkok. The BTS Green Line runs straight through — stations Ratchayothin, Kasetsart University, and Sena Nikhom each put you minutes from a different hotel in this roundup. We reviewed all five properties in depth. Every entry includes direct booking links on three platforms, honest pros and cons, and a clear picture of who each property suits best. Prices from THB 550–800/night.
mrtHtml: The BTS Green Line is the backbone of this district. BTS Ratchayothin is 400 m from Metro Hotel Phahonyothin 35 and 600 m from Pannapat Place. BTS Kasetsart University is 900 m from Livotel Hotel. BTS Sena Nikhom is 400 m from P24 at Kaset (directly opposite the university). Bang Khen SRT Station (Red Line) is 750 m from Room@Vipa, connecting directly to Don Mueang Airport. Properties in this roundup spread across Phahonyothin 34 (Livotel), Phahonyothin 35 (Metro Hotel / Pannapat Place), Phahonyothin 36 (P24 at Kaset), and Vibhavadi 44 (Room@Vipa) — covering both rail users and drivers.

entries.storyHtml: Livotel Hotel @ Kaset Nawamin Bangkok is the most-reviewed 3-star hotel in the Kaset-Nawamin area — 8.6/10 from 1,446 Trip.com reviews, location 8.9, cleanliness 8.7. Its standout advantages are free parking for over 100 cars (including coaches), which is genuinely hard to find in Bangkok, and BTS Kasetsart University reachable by motorbike taxi in 5 minutes. The 159 rooms include a fitness centre and breakfast buffet restaurant. Honest caveat: no swimming pool; some rooms show their age with occasional damp smell; some staff have limited English.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: During graduation ceremonies and major university events, rooms fill up fast — book ahead and call to confirm parking. Ask at check-in for a recently-renovated upper-floor room.

entries.storyHtml: Metro Hotel Phahonyothin 35 opened in 2025 with a clear brief: a clean, modern hotel at a walkable distance from BTS Ratchayothin — 50 rooms, 9.0/10 from 261 Trip.com reviews, staff 9.1, value 9.0, the highest scores in this roundup. entries.storyHtml: Pannapat Place is a 75-room service apartment that has operated on Phahonyothin 35 since 2011 — 8.9/10 from 373 Trip.com reviews, cleanliness 9.1, staff 9.0, value 9.0. These scores, maintained over many years rather than just at opening, speak to consistent quality. Every room has a private balcony, air-conditioning, fridge, LCD TV, and free Wi-Fi. Free parking for guests, a 7-Eleven directly adjacent, and 24-hour front desk round out the offer. Honest caveat: BTS Ratchayothin is 600 m, an 8-minute walk; Wi-Fi can be inconsistent — prepare a mobile hotspot for heavy online work; bathrooms are narrow relative to the room size.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Request an upper-floor room at check-in if noise is a concern — some lower-floor rooms pick up sound from the alley. Carry a mobile hotspot if you rely on stable internet for work.

entries.storyHtml: P24 at Kaset is a 26-room boutique aparthotel in Thai-loft industrial style, directly opposite Kasetsart University Bangkhen. BTS Sena Nikhom is 400 m away (5-min walk). Trip.com scores 8.7 from 140 reviews; Booking.com Staff score is 9.8 — the highest in this roundup — with many guests returning 10+ times. The ground-floor cafe serves quality coffee. Every room has a private balcony, air-conditioning, fridge, and 32-inch LCD TV. Honest caveat: no lift — rooms on upper floors require stairs (note if travelling with heavy luggage); Wi-Fi scores 6.7/10 on Booking.com, well below other categories — bring a mobile hotspot; the alley entrance is narrow and hard for drivers to find on the first visit.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Tell your Grab or taxi driver "opposite the main gate of Kasetsart University Bangkhen" — much easier to find than the alley name. If you have heavy luggage, request a ground-floor room at check-in since there is no lift.

entries.storyHtml: Room@Vipa is a 33-room boutique guesthouse on Vibhavadi Rangsit 44, open since 2014 — the lowest-priced property in this roundup from THB 550/night. Trip.com scores 8.7 from 89 reviews, with location rated 9.2 (highest in this roundup). Bang Khen SRT Red Line station is 750 m away (10-min walk), providing direct access to Don Mueang Airport. The building has a lift, a shared pantry on floor 3 (fridge, microwave, toaster), and free parking for guests. The distinctive character of this property is a home-like atmosphere that brings guests back repeatedly — several TripAdvisor reviews are from guests who have stayed more than ten times. Honest caveat: beds in some rooms are firm and pillows hard; the alley is deep and hard to locate for first-time visitors; some rooms have minimal furniture without a work desk.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Share your location via the hotel's Line contact before arriving — the alley can be hard to find and the team responds very quickly on Line. The Bang Khen Red Line train to Don Mueang Airport costs a fraction of a Grab ride.

faqTitle: FAQ — Budget Hotels Near Kasetsart University Bangkok

faq.q: ❓ What is the best budget hotel near Kasetsart University Bangkok?
faq.a: It depends on your priority. For the most-reviewed property with the largest free car park, Livotel Hotel (THB 700, 8.6 score, 1,446 reviews) is the area anchor. For the highest guest score in a brand-new hotel, choose Metro Hotel Phahonyothin 35 (THB 800, score 9.0, opened 2025, BTS 400 m). For a private balcony and long track record of cleanliness, Pannapat Place (THB 700, cleanliness 9.1) is hard to beat. For the most design-forward boutique opposite the campus, P24 at Kaset (THB 800, staff 9.8) stands apart. For the lowest price, Room@Vipa from THB 550.

faq.q: ❓ Which hotel in this roundup is closest to a BTS station?
faq.a: Metro Hotel Phahonyothin 35 and P24 at Kaset are both approximately 400 m from their nearest BTS station — a 5-minute walk. Metro Hotel is 400 m from BTS Ratchayothin (Green Line). P24 at Kaset is 400 m from BTS Sena Nikhom (Green Line), directly opposite Kasetsart University. Pannapat Place is 600 m from BTS Ratchayothin (8-min walk). Livotel Hotel is 900 m from BTS Kasetsart University — most guests take a motorbike taxi.

faq.q: ❓ Which hotels near Kasetsart University offer free parking?
faq.a: All five properties offer free parking for guests. Livotel Hotel has the largest car park — 100+ spaces including coaches, the best option for larger vehicles or group trips from upcountry. Metro Hotel Phahonyothin 35 offers secure free in-building parking. Pannapat Place and Room@Vipa both have free guest parking. P24 at Kaset has limited free parking — notify the hotel in advance during busy university events.

faq.q: ❓ How do I get from Kaset-Nawamin to Don Mueang Airport?
faq.a: Kaset-Nawamin is one of Bangkok's more convenient districts for Don Mueang Airport. Room@Vipa offers the easiest rail link — Bang Khen SRT Red Line station is 750 m away (10-min walk), and the Red Line runs directly to Don Mueang Airport in approximately 15 minutes at very low cost. From other properties in this roundup, a Grab or taxi to Don Mueang takes approximately 20–25 minutes and costs around THB 150–250 depending on traffic.

faq.q: ❓ Is the Kaset-Nawamin area good for tourists visiting Bangkok?
faq.a: Kaset-Nawamin is primarily a residential and university district — ideal for anyone with business at Kasetsart University, Paolo Kaset Hospital, or the Chatuchak-Ratchayothin area. For tourists, the BTS Green Line connects to central Bangkok (Siam, Asok, Mo Chit) within 20–30 minutes, and the district itself has Or-Tor-Kor Market, student-priced street food, and Major Ratchayothin mall nearby. The main advantage is significantly lower accommodation prices than central Bangkok for the same star rating.

faq.q: ❓ Which is the cheapest hotel near Kasetsart University Bangkok?
faq.a: Room@Vipa is the lowest-priced property in this roundup — Single Room (shared bathroom) from approximately THB 550/night, Twin/Double with private bathroom from THB 750/night. Despite the low price, it scores 8.7/10 on Trip.com with a location score of 9.2, and many guests are loyal repeat visitors. Livotel Hotel and Pannapat Place both start from around THB 700/night. Metro Hotel and P24 at Kaset start from THB 800/night.
